why: Phase C fix A (#2304, prod 2026-10-13 Macro Musings 'John Rolle on The Bahamas...'): the show's recorded intro ('I am your host, David Beckworth ... produced by ... mercatus.org ... subscribe') is typed an ad (an edge intro clip, K10), and the ad-reader filter then dropped the FEED-STATED host from the host pool. With an empty pool the host voice stayed unnamed and the no-stated-host step could seat the guest. The filter exists for names guessed from the transcript; a host the feed states is still the host when his own voice reads the intro.
